verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm offering legal services, with free web resources such as LathamDrive, a document generator and a glossary app. Official developer SDKs fall outside that product category, so this is a wrong-axis question. Nothing in the evidence shows a shipped SDK, and the probes found no API surface (llms.txt and all OpenAPI paths returned 404), so the na exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
